systems.platform: DHIS2, in offline and web-based versions
systems.tiers: over 4,000 primary health care institutions (district hospitals, health centres, health posts and woreda health offices), said to be 95% of those eligible; close to 30% of 194 surveyed facilities used it mainly offline

note: A study of the health ministry's DHIS2 in primary health care units of four regions, 2013 to 2022: woreda health offices appear as the managers of sampled facilities and as a sampling frame, and nothing is stated about the connection of any woreda office. DHIS2 is classed application because woreda health offices are among its users; the parent may prefer central.
